verdict.rationale: Relay's marketing says users can create invoices, request payments, and "let Relay handle the follow-up," and its support docs describe branded invoices with built-in payment collection. That directly claims automated invoice follow-up within the invoicing tool. However, the claim rests on a single marketing line with no documentation of how overdue reminders actually work. Missing for 10: documentation of overdue-specific reminder behavior (timing, cadence, customization), confirmation that follow-up triggers on overdue status rather than only at sending, plan/tier availability, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
